cover_text: Tabs are not a reading system
script: If your browser has become your reading list, this is for you. I used to save articles with the best intentions, then never return. ArticlePod changes the habit: capture the article, let it become audio, and listen while walking, cooking, driving, or doing the small parts of the day where reading is impossible.

script: Some of the best reading is trapped in PDFs: reports, essays, papers, long memos. ArticlePod supports text-based PDFs, so those documents can become private podcast episodes too. If a PDF is scanned or image-heavy, we fail clearly instead of pretending the text exists. The goal is reliable listening, not mystery output.
